title: UFO professor privately agrees UFOs aren't from other planets

tellings.quote: and anyways I'm I'm with him at some conference where like by the bar and I'm like I'm like if you actually use inductive logic these things are not from other planets and he like looks at me and he sort of like Whispers and he's like you're right

plain: A professor known for studying UFOs privately admitted, around 2019 or 2020, that he did not think they come from other planets. Michels tells this himself, without naming the professor: standing at a bar during a conference, he argued that careful reasoning shows "these things are not from other planets," and the professor looked at him and whispered, "you're right." Michels tells it as a sign that experts may believe something stranger in private than they say in public.
